notes: Source: Los Angeles Rams 2026 Media Guide (IA item los-angeles-rams-2026-media-guide, 603 pages; PDF page = printed page number). Records are in two sections: 'RAMS ALL-TIME INDIVIDUAL RECORDS' pp. 445-454 (career and season top-10 tables pp. 445-446, year-by-year leaders pp. 446-452, 'RAMS BIG DAYS' game lists pp. 452-454) and 'REGULAR SEASON INDIVIDUAL RECORDS' pp. 464-473 (top-3 lists for Career / Season / Game per category). Every digit used was checked on 200-300 dpi crops of the page pictures.

through_season 2025: the p445-446 tables include 2025 seasons (Stafford 4,707 yards and 46 TD; Nacua 129 receptions and 1,715 yards), the Big Days lists include games of Dec. 18, 2025, and this is the 2026 edition (IA date 2026-09-09).

List choice: where an ALL-TIME table (pp. 445-446: top 10, printed rank numbers with 't' for ties, up to date through 2025) and a REGULAR SEASON list (pp. 464-473: top 3, no rank numbers) rank the same stat, the ALL-TIME table was used (career pass_yds, rush_yds, rec, rec_yds, int; season pass_yds, rush_yds, rec, rec_yds, int). Game yardage uses the RAMS BIG DAYS lists (top 5 copied, they agree with the top-3 game lists on pp. 466, 467, 469). Everything else (career/season/game rush_td, pass_td, rec_td; game rec; career and season tackles) exists only on pp. 464-473 and was copied from there.

Ranks on pp. 464-473: the guide prints no rank numbers. Rank = printed position, tied values share the lowest rank (1,1,3 ...) and carry tie=true. Where a number is printed once above several stacked names, the number is repeated at the start of each row's raw so the value is visible in raw.

GUIDE INCONSISTENCIES (pp. 464-473 are partly stale or wrong against the guide's own pp. 445-446; rows were copied as printed, not corrected): (a) p468 career TD passes lists Gabriel 154, Everett 142, Bulger 122 but p445 prints Stafford 141 (2021-Pres.), so Stafford should rank 3rd; the p445 TD column of the yards-ranked passers is Gabriel 154, Everett 142, Stafford 141, Bulger 122, Van Brocklin 118, Goff 107, Warner 102, Waterfield 99, Ferragamo 70, Bradford 59. (b) p468 season TD passes (Stafford 2021 and Warner 1999 at 41, Warner 2001 at 36) omits Stafford 2025: 46 TD (p445, p446). (c) p467 season passing yards prints Goff 2018 as 4,668 (p445 and the p446 year-by-year print 4,688) and omits Stafford 2025 (4,707). (d) p469 career receptions (top 3 ends with Ellard 593) omits Kupp 634 (p445); p469 season receptions omits Nacua 2025 (129); p469 season receiving yards omits Kupp 2021 (1,947) and Nacua 2025 (1,715). (e) p470 career receiving TDs (Bruce 84, Holt 74, Hirsch 53) omits Kupp 57 (p445 TD column). (f) p473 season combined tackles (top 145, Ernest Jones 2023) conflicts with the p451 year-by-year Tackles table (Fletcher 193 in 2000 and 189 in 2001, Collins 185 in 1984, Laurinaitis 174 in 2012). (g) p468 prints Everett's career as 1986-92 where pp. 445 and 467 print 1986-93.

Extra column entries: career pass_td, career rec_td and season pass_td also carry kind=column lists (the TD column of the p445 tables) because the top-3 lists on pp. 468 and 470 are stale (see (a), (b), (e)); the kind=list entries remain the guide's own record lists. Sacks: the guide prints no ranked sack list. career/sacks and game/sacks are missing; season/sacks is the p451 year-by-year team-leader table ('Sacks (not an official stat until 1982)') transcribed as kind=column with only the 22 rows of 13.0 or more sacks (Deacon Jones 22.0 in 1964 and in 1968, 21.0 in 1967; Aaron Donald 20.5 in 2018). Treat it as a derived, not a printed, record.

Interceptions: pp. 464-473 contain no defender interception section ('HAD INTERCEPTED' is quarterbacks' passes thrown, not used). career/season int come from the p445/p446 ALL-TIME tables; game int is missing.

Names: 'Last, First' rearranged to first-last; positional tags such as (RB), (DE) dropped from name (kept in raw); nicknames in parentheses kept as printed (Paul (Tank) Younger, David (Deacon) Jones, Dick (Night Train) Lane). Kyren Williams is printed first-last on p445. Spellings and typos are kept in raw (for example 'San Fracisco' in the Kupp game-reception row).

Years: career spans keep the printed form ('1994-07' on pp. 445-446, '1994-2007' on pp. 464-473; '2021-Pres.' marks a player the guide still lists as active). Game rows: years holds the date as M/D/YYYY (two-digit printed years expanded) followed by the printed opponent text. The lists carry every franchise year the guide prints (for example Waterfield 1945-52, Everett 1986-93, Bulger 2001-09); the guide does not separate franchise eras in these lists.
Aggregate lines such as '3 Many times, last by Cam Akers, vs. Arizona, 9/16/18' are not player rows and were not copied, so game rush_td has one row and game rec_td four.

Other guide typos seen but not used: p453 prints 'Matthew Staffprd' (389 yards, Oct. 2, 2025) and gives Tom Fears's Dec. 3, 1950 game as '3 receptions' in the Big Days receiving list while p469 gives him 18 receptions that day.
